title: rate-limiter: remove obsolete redis_fallback config references
reasoning:
## Summary

The `redis_fallback` config key is referenced across `plugins/config.yaml`, docs, the OCP helm chart, and several tests, but the current rate-limiter plugin (`cpex-rate-limiter`, the Rust port) does not recognize it. Operators using the shipped configs see a `"rate limiter: unknown config key(s): redis_fallback"` WARN at gateway boot and no behavior change. The docs describe a mechanism that no longer exists.

## Background

`redis_fallback` was a real config key in the in-tree Python rate-limiter plugin and was honored as documented (fall back to in-memory counting when Redis was unavailable). It became silently no-op when the in-tree plugin was replaced by the `cpex-rate-limiter` package. Behavior under unreachable Redis is now governed by `fail_mode` (default `"open"`).
